title: NASA Sun fact sheet: mass conversion rate 4260.
summary: The Sun fact sheet lists mass conversion rate as 4260.
body: NASA's Sun fact sheet lists Mass conversion rate (10 6 kg/s) as 4260. for the Sun. Listed under bulk parameters, not under the model-center heading. The sheet does not say this is a laboratory measurement. Mass, volumetric mean radius, luminosity, spectral type, and the sidereal rotation period are on other cards and are not repeated as the claim here. Last Updated line: 9 May 2024.
